title: Factorial Trailing Zeroes
statement_short: Given an integer n, return the number of trailing zeroes in n!. Follow up: Could you write a solution that works in logarithmic time complexity?
hint: Logarithmic time follow-up requires counting factors of 5 by repeatedly dividing n by 5.
why_not: Right: Math / Geometry counts factors of 5 in n! using n/5 + n/25 + ... in O(log n) time and O(1) space. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming subproblem state caching is unnecessary for direct factor counting. Not Binary Search: The solution calculates exact factor multiples rather than searching a sorted array range. Not Bit Manipulation: Trailing zeroes in decimal factorials depend on factors of 10 (2\*5) rather than bitwise shifts.
